attrs.remaining_trust: TWO THINGS, and the first is the larger. (1) The EDGE side is not exhausted: this quantifies over the edges in a DECLARED-SYNTHETIC fixture, not over all expressible edges, so it re-runs per fixture rather than holding once. A rule language admitting an edge this fixture does not contain is unconstrained by it. (2) The kind set is closed within a schema revision and extensible across one; a revision adding a sixth kind makes the domain 64 and 729 and must re-run. That is stated in impact_algebra.extensibility and nothing enforces the re-run.
attrs.rule: complete enumeration of a finite domain DEFINED by the artifact under test
